messages.content: Here is the context of my K3s cluster 'Elysium'. The control plane is atlantis (192.168.1.160), with worker nodes avalon, phantom (192.168.1.170), olympus, and pi. ArgoCD syncs git@github.com:alvish96/Elysium.git over SSH.

Understood. I have recorded the Elysium cluster context. Control plane: atlantis (192.168.1.160). GitOps: ArgoCD via SSH (id_ed25519) watching git@github.com:alvish96/Elysium.git. Storage: MergerFS cascading pools (nexus_pool, tvshows_pool, movies_pool, audio_pool) and LVM SSD appdata (/mnt/internal/appdata).
What are the core network rules and service configurations we established?

Core Network & Service Configurations:
1. Gluetun VPN Proxy: Running inside qbittorrent pod, exposing HTTP proxy at http://qbittorrent-svc:8888.
2. FlareSolverr: Running internally on http://flaresolverr-svc:8191.
3. Trawl: Stateless failover preference on avalon (weight 100) -> phantom (weight 50).
4. Node Pinger: DaemonSet in monitoring namespace pinging Healthchecks.io for atlantis, avalon, phantom, olympus, and pi using 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8.
5. DNS Warning: Never use .aura wildcard DNS rewrites in AdGuard/Tailscale to avoid TLS cert loops.
